text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Did you need something from me? Want me to 
play hero with you?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Not even close! I came here today to scout 
you as a hero, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I feel like it's not different at all, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about you, Tannhauser-senpai! 
You give everything your all and never 
give up...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Fighting a good fight means putting up a 
noble battle, right? That's why 
Tannhauser-senpai is a magnificent hero!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Listen, "fighting hard" doesn't mean... 
Ugh... It's so embarrassing having to 
explain it myself.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's protect the academy's peace 
together again today! Tannhauser Brown!
